summary: 100 ft Aermotor MC-39 on the Bienville National Forest in Smith County, MS; last of eight towers built 1934-1940, Clear Springs built 1937-1939 per NHLR; still standing per the register.

events.note: Register gives a range, sometime between 1937 and 1939; 1937 is the earliest year of that range
Registered July 9, 2023 as US 1739, MS 56; nominated by Jason Johns

evidence.supports: location Bienville National Forest, Smith County
tower described as a 100ft Aermotor MC-39
evidence.quote: This tower is a 100ft Aermotor MC-39

evidence.supports: eight fire towers on the Bienville National Forest built 1934 to 1940
evidence.quote: On the Bienville National Forest eight fire towers were built from 1934 to 1940.

evidence.supports: Clear Springs was the last tower erected, sometime between 1937 and 1939
evidence.quote: The last of the fire towers to be erected was Clear Springs Tower sometime between 1937 and 1939.

corrections.why: The register gives a range (Sometime Between 1937-1939), not a single year.
The register describes it as a 100ft Aermotor MC-39 tower.

notes_for_editor: The register's history of the eight Bienville towers is detailed and gives the build range for this tower. The register's 1934 start for the towers conflicts with Wikipedia's June 15, 1936 establishment date for the forest; left unresolved. A search snippet attributed to a National Park Service nomination gave March 26, 1934 for the forest's start; that source was not read and is not cited. The Moore NRHP nomination (npgallery def15102) was read and its cached text has no mention of Clear Springs. Not found: staffing, fires watched, access status, or any current condition beyond the register's remains standing line. Two web searches and the Bienville Wikipedia article were the only other sources read. The 2020 Secretary of State state land list has a Smith County Tower under Forestry Commission; that is a state site, not this Forest Service tower. Suggested next steps: Bienville ranger district office in Forest, and Mississippi Department of Archives and History.
